decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The first floor rear extension, by reason of its design, appearance and proximity to the adjoining properties, would represent an obtrusive and unneighbourly development, which would harm the living conditions of the adjoining neighbours, by reason of enclosure, shading, and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines

Condition : 2 - The first floor rear extension, by reason of its bulk, design and appearance would be at odds with the original character of this distinctive property and would fail to enhance or preserve the Heston Village Conservation Area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension to house.
